The documents don't directly list Gasly's 2023 teammate. Document [4] (2023 United States Grand Prix) places Pierre Gasly at Alpine F1 Team, but it doesn't show who else drove for Alpine that year. Documents [1], [2], and [3] show Esteban Ocon at Alpine in 2021 and 2022, and Gasly's 2025 Alpine entry in [8] doesn't name a teammate. Combining these, Gasly and Ocon were Alpine teammates in 2023, and that matches my general knowledge of the season, though the documents alone don't fully confirm it.

ANSWER: Esteban Ocon
